name: prometheus-exporters
title: Prometheus exporters
description: Node Exporter (host CPU, memory, disks, network) and cAdvisor (per-container resources) for the Prometheus template. Both listen on 127.0.0.1 only; deploy into the stack that runs Prometheus and add the scrape targets node-exporter:9100 and cadvisor:8080 to its prometheus.yml.
